newsitem.title: USA: Tadiran unit not awarded added contract.
newsitem.headline: Tadiran unit not awarded added contract.

text.p: Israel's Tadiran Ltd said on Monday that its subsidiary, Tallahassee Communications, received notice that General Dynamics Corp was not awarded a follow-on U.S. defense radio systems pact.
Tallahassee Communications will continue to manufacture the radio systems under existing orders for production until the second half of 1998, Tadiran said.
Tallahassee Communications, under a teaming agreement with General Dynamics Land Systems, has been a second supplier of the radio systems to the U.S. Army since the late 1980s, Tadiran said.
The U.S. Army has now decided to award the balance of the program to a single vendor, Tadiran said.

Tadiran said it does not expect this notification to have a material adverse effect on its business. The company said it will use its Tallahassee facility to make other advanced radio frequency products.
